product_summary: Chennai (Tamil Nadu) based manufacturer of PHARMACEUTICAL FILM COATING MATERIALS, in business since 1993, brand series 'PROTECTAB'. Real product lines listed on bharatcoats.com/products.php: (1) high-speed sodium alginate based aqueous coating system; (2) HPMC based film coating material; (3) high film strength HPMC based film coating; (4) HPMC based transparent film coating; (5) glitter finish film coating; (6) moisture barrier film coating; (7) CAP / HPMCP combination based enteric coating; (8) methacrylic acid copolymer based enteric coating; (9) intergranular disintegrant / super-disintegrant premix; (10) matrix for sustained release formulations; (11) odour masking coating material; (12) economic HPMC based film coating. These are excipient premixes for tablet coating, sold to pharma formulators (site claims 'film coating introduced to more than 400 customers'). HS mapping: finished coating premix formulations (polymer + plasticiser + pigment, dosed as a preparation) -> 3004 90 99 (medicaments/preparations n.e.s.) or, if traded as separate excipient preparations, 3824 99 99; sodium alginate -> 3913 10 00; HPMC -> 3912 39 19; CAP/HPMCP (cellulose acetate phthalate / hydroxypropyl methylcellulose phthalate) -> 3912 90 90; methacrylic acid copolymer (Eudragit-type) -> 3906 90 90; super-disintegrant premix (cross-linked CMC / sodium starch glycolate type) -> 3505 10 90 or 3912 31 00. Declared 3913 10 00 (alginic acid, its salts and esters, in primary forms) covers ONLY the sodium-alginate-based line and only if shipped as raw polymer, not as a formulated coating premix.
comment: HS 391310 = 'Alginic acid, its salts and esters' — this is a RAW POLYMER code, while the company's catalogue is dominated by formulated film-coating systems (HPMC, CAP/HPMCP, methacrylate copolymers, disintegrant premixes, sustained-release matrices). Match status: WRONG (partial at best — only the sodium alginate line is plausibly covered, and even then only if sold as polymer rather than as a coating preparation). Per Rule 3 the company is NOT rejected: it stays in the base and the code is corrected to the actual product mix (30049099 / 38249999 for coating preparations, 39123919 for HPMC, 39129090 for CAP/HPMCP, 39069090 for methacrylate copolymer, 35051090 for disintegrant premix). INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: declared industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is wrong — this is a pharma excipients / tablet-coating supplier, i.e. pharma-adjacent specialty chemicals, not oil & gas. No petroleum, no petrochemical, no oilfield product anywhere in the catalogue. TRADER SIGNS: none visible — the site describes own R&D team and own product development, consistent with manufacturer, but no factory address, plant capacity or GMP/ISO certificate numbers were readable (certificates page not opened), so 'manufacturer' is asserted by the site only. Product lines MISSING from the declaration: HPMC film coatings, CAP/HPMCP enteric coatings, methacrylic acid copolymer enteric coatings, super-disintegrant premixes, sustained-release matrix systems, moisture-barrier and odour-masking coatings — none of these are covered by 391310. All product claims here are from the company's own website (bharatcoats.com) and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was checked in this task (out of scope per role), so no shipment-level corroboration exists for any code. Note: the legal-entity name given as 'JANARDHANAN RAGUNATHAN' is a personal name, not a company name — the operating brand is 'Bharat Coats', Chennai; entity type (proprietorship/partnership/Pvt Ltd) is not public on the site and is left null.
